summary.text: Jodi Giglio is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly representing District 2, which she has represented since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Giglio lives in Baiting Hollow, New York, and her career experience includes owning a business.
For the 2025-2026 session, Giglio was assigned to the Agriculture, Governmental Employees, Labor, People with Disabilities, Transportation and Ways and Means committees.
